notes: the first route is the Companion's own report of the Prophet's saying, a single link (rule 10)
«حدثنا بذلك» after the saying opens a second isnad with the same saying: a route of its own (rule 4); «عمه حكيم بن معاوية» is one link named by his name (rule 7)
the closing «بهذا» is the same-wording marker, not the «بهذا الإسناد» back-reference: not stored
